input.strategy_title: Experiment comparison for training and pipeline runs
input.strategy_markdown:
## Problem Statement

Data scientists iterate across dozens of training and pipeline runs but have no
way to compare them inside the platform: parameters and metrics live in
per-run pages, so comparison happens in exported spreadsheets. Model promotion
decisions need side-by-side visibility into what changed between candidate
runs and how their metrics differ. (Requirements below were consolidated from
two customer councils; some overlap in wording was kept from the sources.)

## High-Level Requirements

| ID | Priority | Requirement |
|-------|----------|-------------|
| HLR-1 | P0 | Users can select two or more runs and view their parameters and metrics side by side in the Dashboard. |
| HLR-2 | P1 | Registered model versions link back to the run that produced them, so a comparison can be opened from the Model Registry. |
| HLR-3 | P1 | Provide a run "diff" view that highlights which parameters and metrics changed between two selected runs. |
| HLR-4 | P2 | Documentation covers the comparison workflow from both the runs list and the registry. |

## Affected Components

- Dashboard
- Model Registry
- Data Science Pipelines

## Out of Scope

- Automatic best-run selection or promotion
- Comparison across clusters or across projects

## Open Questions

None.

# Dashboard run comparison view (side-by-side and diff)

## Description

Delivers a run comparison capability in the Dashboard: users select two or more training or pipeline runs and view their parameters and metrics side by side, with a diff presentation that highlights which parameters and metrics changed between two selected runs. Today parameters and metrics are visible only on per-run pages, which forces comparison into exported spreadsheets; this epic gives data scientists side-by-side visibility inside the platform for model promotion decisions.

## Scope

- Multi-run selection (two or more runs) from the existing runs list.
- A comparison view rendering each selected run's parameters and metrics side by side.
- A diff presentation of the comparison that highlights which parameters and metrics differ between two selected runs.
- The comparison consumes run parameters and metrics already surfaced by the Dashboard on per-run pages; no new backend data surfaces are in scope.
- Validation that the comparison works over Data Science Pipelines runs as well as training runs (Data Science Pipelines requires no code changes in this strategy — its run data is already exposed to the Dashboard).
- Out of scope: automatic best-run selection or promotion, and comparison across clusters or across projects.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Two or more runs selected from the runs list open a comparison view showing each selected run's parameters and metrics side by side.
- Given two selected runs, the comparison highlights which parameters and metrics changed between them.
- The comparison renders parameters and metrics for Data Science Pipelines runs from the existing per-run data, with no code changes required in Data Science Pipelines.
- Comparison is offered within a project's runs only; no cross-cluster or cross-project comparison is exposed (out-of-scope guard).

## HLR Traceability

- HLR-1 (P0): users can select two or more runs and view their parameters and metrics side by side in the Dashboard.
- HLR-3 (P1): a run "diff" view highlighting which parameters and metrics changed between two selected runs — covered by the same comparison surface as HLR-1 (one capability consolidated into this epic at the higher priority, since the diff view is a presentation mode of the same comparison over the same run data).

# Model Registry run lineage and comparison entry point

## Description

Records, on each registered model version, a link back to the run that produced it, and adds an entry point in the registry UI that opens the run comparison for the linked run — so a comparison can be started from the Model Registry, not only from the runs list. This closes the loop between experiment iteration and model promotion: a candidate version in the registry can be traced to its producing run and compared against alternatives without leaving the platform.

## Scope

- Attach the producing run reference to registered model versions, using the registry's established model-version metadata extension point for structured data.
- A registry UI affordance on a model version that opens the run comparison including the linked run, deep-linking into the Dashboard comparison view delivered by the run comparison capability.
- The entry point works for both training runs and Data Science Pipelines runs referenced by a model version.
- Out of scope: automatic best-run selection or promotion, and comparison across clusters or across projects.

## Notes

- The run-lineage metadata work (attaching the producing run reference to registered model versions) is independent of the Dashboard run comparison view and may start in parallel with it. The epic-level dependency on the comparison view exists only for the registry UI entry point, which builds against that view's selection and deep-link contract — the lineage half need not wait.

## Acceptance Criteria

- A registered model version records the run that produced it.
- From a registered model version in the registry UI, the user can open a run comparison that includes the linked run.
- The run comparison opened from the registry renders for model versions whose producing run is a training run or a Data Science Pipelines run.

## HLR Traceability

- HLR-2 (P1): registered model versions link back to the run that produced them, so a comparison can be opened from the Model Registry.

# Document the run comparison workflow

## Description

Documentation for the new run comparison capability, covering the workflow from both entry points: the runs list in the Dashboard and the Model Registry. Gives data scientists a reference for comparing candidate runs and understanding what changed between them when making promotion decisions.

## Scope

Content outline:

- A new documentation topic on comparing training and pipeline runs: selecting two or more runs from the runs list, reading the side-by-side parameters and metrics view, and using the diff highlighting between two selected runs.
- A section on opening a comparison from the Model Registry: following a model version's run lineage link and starting the comparison from the registry.
- Cross-link updates in the existing runs-list and Model Registry documentation topics that point to the new comparison workflow (reference updates only; no new content beyond the comparison topics).

## Acceptance Criteria

- A published documentation topic covers the comparison workflow from the runs list: multi-run selection, the side-by-side parameters/metrics view, and the diff highlighting between two runs.
- A published documentation section covers opening a comparison from the Model Registry via a model version's run lineage.
- The documentation is technically reviewed against the implemented behavior of the run comparison capability and the registry entry point before publication.

## HLR Traceability

- HLR-4 (P2): documentation covers the comparison workflow from both the runs list and the registry.
